searchIntent.title: Fastest way to share code online
searchIntent.subtitle: LiveShare is made for one work — paste code, get link, work together live.
searchIntent.body: You want to share code online with friend or candidate? LiveShare give you live browser editor. Good for remote pair programming, technical interview and quick debugging. No VS Code install. No account wall. Just open room and send URL.
searchIntent.point1Desc: Make one unique link and share code in few seconds. Anyone with browser can open.
searchIntent.point2Desc: Both people type in same editor. Changes sync live — no screen share problem.
searchIntent.point3Desc: Skip whiteboard. See candidate coding live, teach student, or debug together.

retention.title: Want to keep this session?
retention.subtitle: Bookmark this room or start new one for next share.
retention.bookmarkDesc: Press {{shortcut}} to bookmark this link in browser.

howItWorks.title: How Live Share Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Live share your code in 4 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Click "Share Code Now" to start live share
howItWorks.step3Desc: Paste or write code with syntax highlighting
howItWorks.step4Desc: Share your unique link so others can work together live.

features.teamDesc: Open LiveShare editor, write or copy code, then share with friends and colleagues. Pair program and fix bugs together.
features.interviewDesc: Give coding task and watch live when interview is remote or in office. Nobody like writing code on whiteboard.
features.teachDesc: Share code with students and explain. Many colleges and universities use LiveShare every day.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose LiveShare?
whyChoose.instantDesc: No sign-up need. Share code in seconds.
whyChoose.syntaxDesc: Nice highlighting for all popular languages.
whyChoose.passwordDesc: You can put password on room if you want privacy.

cta.subtitle: Fast way to share code, work together in real time, and build things.

whyDevs.title: Why Developers Choose LiveShare
whyDevs.subtitle: Share code with features made for dev teams.
whyDevs.fastDesc: Share code with one click. No waiting, no setup, no tension. Your shared workspace ready in seconds.
whyDevs.syncDesc: See changes right away when team code together. Good for pair programming, code review and remote work.
whyDevs.secureDesc: Put password on session and control who can open your code. Your work stay private.

howWorks.title: How LiveShare Works (3 steps)
howWorks.subtitle: Paste code → get link → share and work together live.
howWorks.step1Desc: Open editor room and paste your code. LiveShare keep it fast — no setup need.
howWorks.step2Desc: Room link is made automatically. Others can open and join quickly.
howWorks.step3Desc: Work together in real time. Changes sync live while you discuss and improve code.
